_comment: Captions and voice-over for the demo video. 'text' is shown on screen; 'say' (optional) is what the voice reads when it should differ. Order follows record_demo.mjs.

intro.title: Meet SemanticLift
intro.text: Decades of Cognos reports hide a semantic layer. SemanticLift lifts it out onto the cloud data platform.
intro.say: Decades of Cognos reports hide a semantic layer. Semantic Lift lifts it out, onto your cloud data platform.

problem.title: The problem
problem.text: Report sprawl, business logic trapped in the BI tool, the same KPI with different numbers, unknown lineage.
problem.say: The problem: report sprawl, business logic trapped inside the BI tool, the same KPI giving different numbers, and lineage nobody can trace.

how.title: How it works
how.text: Eight steps from estate to production: the tool does the analysis and generation, people make the decisions.
how.say: Eight steps take the estate to production. The tool does the analysis and the generation. People make the decisions.

numbers.title: The lift, in numbers
numbers.text: Figures from the open project: 588 reports analysed, 85% fewer to migrate, 70 KPI conflicts surfaced before build.
numbers.say: In this project: five hundred and eighty-eight reports analysed, eighty-five percent fewer to migrate, and seventy KPI conflicts surfaced before anything is built.

projects.title: Client projects
projects.text: Each client engagement is an isolated project, with its progress, roles and an audit trail.
projects.say: Each client engagement is its own isolated project, with progress, roles, and an audit trail.

ingest.title: Upload & run
ingest.text: Upload one Cognos export. Every file is detected and parsed, and stated counts are reconciled.
ingest.say: Upload one Cognos export. Every file is detected and parsed, and the stated counts are reconciled.

strategy.title: Strategy & approach
strategy.text: The playbook: for each step why it matters, what SemanticLift does, the team guideline, the outcome and this project’s figures.
strategy.say: The playbook explains each step: why it matters, what Semantic Lift does, the guideline for the team, and the outcome, with this project's own figures.

rationalization.title: 1. Report rationalization
rationalization.text: Every report gets Keep, Review, Consolidate or Retire, with the rule and evidence behind it.
rationalization.say: Step one. Every report gets an outcome: keep, review, consolidate or retire, with the rule and the evidence behind it.

decide.title: 1. Report rationalization
decide.text: The steward reviews the evidence and decides: this one is kept. The decision is saved and audited.
decide.say: The steward reviews the evidence and decides to keep this one. The decision is saved and audited.

kpi_lineage.title: 2. KPI lineage
kpi_lineage.text: Trace any KPI: KPI → Framework Manager item → reports → database → schema → table.
kpi_lineage.say: Step two. Trace any KPI, from the Framework Manager item, through the reports, down to the database, schema and table.

common_kpis.title: 3. Common KPIs
common_kpis.text: KPIs that reports calculate differently are surfaced up front, and a steward approves the correct definition.
common_kpis.say: Step three. KPIs that reports calculate differently are surfaced up front, and a steward approves the correct definition.

sources.title: 4. Databases & tables
sources.text: Only the tables surviving reports really read are in scope; tables used only by Review reports are flagged.
sources.say: Step four. Only the tables that surviving reports really read are in scope. Tables used only by reports under review are flagged.

ldm.title: 5. Logical data model
ldm.text: A conformed model of facts and dimensions, with join-path risks diagnosed.
ldm.say: Step five. A conformed model of facts and dimensions, with join-path risks diagnosed.

products.title: 6. Data products & semantic layer
products.text: Business logic leaves Cognos: semantic views, aggregated views, policies and data-product contracts.
products.say: Step six. The business logic leaves Cognos, as semantic views, aggregated views, security policies and data-product contracts.

apply.title: Apply decisions
apply.text: Saved decisions reach the design with one click: the pipeline re-runs in the background.
apply.say: Saved decisions reach the design with one click. The pipeline re-runs in the background.

aggregates.title: Aggregated views
aggregates.text: A few pre-summarised tables answer the busiest reports from hundreds of rows instead of millions.
aggregates.say: A few pre-summarised tables answer the busiest reports from hundreds of rows, instead of millions.

objects.title: 7. Object lineage
objects.text: Every platform object traced: its sources, the semantic objects it feeds and the reports it serves.
objects.say: Step seven. Every platform object is traced: its sources, the semantic objects it feeds, and the reports it serves.

review.title: Design review
review.text: Nothing deploys without a person. Approvers see the generated DDL next to the Cognos source.
review.say: Nothing deploys without a person. Approvers see the generated code next to the original Cognos logic.

deploy.title: Deploy & validate
deploy.text: Approved objects are committed to Git and deployed by CI; parity SQL proves the numbers still match.
deploy.say: Approved objects are committed to Git and deployed by the pipeline, and parity checks prove the numbers still match.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.text: Every upload, run and decision, attributed to a person, ready for the client’s governance team.
audit.say: Every upload, run and decision is attributed to a person, ready for the client's governance team.

outro.title: Lift the meaning
outro.text: SemanticLift: fewer reports, one truth per KPI, a governed semantic layer, proven.
outro.say: Semantic Lift. Fewer reports. One truth per KPI. A governed semantic layer, proven.
